conditions.notes: CLM-0022 holds that no transformation may silently replace its origin. OBS-0020 exhibits operators/reflect.py staging an element whose verbatim origin is whitespace, accepted as CONSISTENT. This challenges the claim as an operative property of the field, not as a normative commitment: the commitment is stated in FIELD.md section 2 and proved of the model in Invariants.lean, and the intake path enforces it nowhere. The challenge is dissolved by a fix, which is why it is challenges rather than contradicts-under-conditions.
